name: Palakkad
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Kerala's Directorate of Survey and Land Records lists Palakkad district survey, re-survey and digitization offices; the official Bhu-Naksha/e-Maps viewer describes Kerala cadastral parcel mapping; the Government of India DILRMP page has a Palakkad tehsil-level cadastral digitization record. These establish a relevant local/state registry custodian and official map program, but not an open city-bound parcel feature response.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The official cadastral viewer was discoverable but its current page could not be retrieved by direct TLS-verified curl because the certificate was expired. Search inspection confirms parcel-map functionality, but no anonymous native-ID-plus-full-polygon response, schema, CRS or bounded city response was verified. Ente Bhoomi presents live land parcel maps behind login, which was not attempted.

requests.summary: Direct anonymous request was stopped by normal TLS verification. No certificate exception was used. Search inspection of the official page describes area-of-interest, resurvey sketches, block/survey/subdivision search and plot information, but did not expose a retrievable JSON schema or endpoint.

Direct anonymous request was stopped by normal TLS verification; no retry with disabled verification, login, token or CAPTCHA bypass. Official search inspection describes integrated cadastral mapping and a digital sketch for individual parcels.
Official Malayalam portal retrieved. It advertises real-time land parcel maps and integrated land services, but access is via single-sign-on/login. No login or personal/property query was attempted.

Official Directorate page retrieved and lists Survey Deputy Director, Assistant Director Re-Survey, District Survey Superintendent, Re-Survey Superintendent and District Digitization Centre for Palakkad. This is local/state custody evidence, not parcel geometry.

requests.summary: Government of India DILRMP Palakkad page was identified by first-party web inspection and records Palakkad tehsils and cadastral-map digitization fields. Direct request was stopped by normal TLS verification; no exception used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kerala Bhu-Naksha/e-Maps cadastral viewer, Ente Bhoomi integrated land-information portal, Directorate of Survey and Land Records Palakkad offices, and Government of India DILRMP Palakkad digitization status.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service descriptions, Palakkad survey-office custody and a login-gated land-parcel-map portal were verified. No anonymous native identity, parcel geometry, CRS or citywide extent was verified.

technicalBlocker: TLS certificate validation blocked direct retrieval of the Bhu-Naksha viewer and DILRMP page. Ente Bhoomi is login-gated for land parcel maps. No exact-point hit or miss was obtained and none is treated as evidence of citywide absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identifier if exposed
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Bhu-Naksha viewer exposes a machine-readable anonymous geometry service after certificate recovery, and whether the Palakkad urban area is covered by that service, remains unresolved.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may retry the official viewer with normal TLS verification after certificate recovery and independently qualify an adapter only if a bounded anonymous response contains a stable native parcel identity and full polygon.
